Package org.cibseven.spin.impl.json.jackson.format

Class JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2EnumContainerDeserializers

java.lang.Object
tools.jackson.databind.deser.Deserializers.Base
org.cibseven.spin.impl.json.jackson.format.JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2EnumContainerDeserializers
All Implemented Interfaces:
tools.jackson.databind.deser.Deserializers
Enclosing class:
JacksonJsonDataFormat
public static class JacksonJsonDataFormat.Jackson2EnumContainerDeserializers extends tools.jackson.databind.deser.Deserializers.Base
Properties declared as Map with an enum key or as Set of an enum, read as LinkedHashMap and HashSet like Jackson 2; Jackson 3 alone reads them as EnumMap and EnumSet (databind#1853), which changes the key order of a variable that is read and stored again and rejects null in such a set. Only the deserializer of these two declarations is chosen here, so type ids of polymorphic values, @JsonDeserialize(as = ...) and all other declarations stay as they are: an abstract type mapping Map -> LinkedHashMap would also become the default implementation of polymorphic values and accept missing or unknown type ids. The value instantiator is the JDK default of LinkedHashMap or HashSet and class annotations are read from the declared Map or Set: value instantiators or mix-ins an application registers for LinkedHashMap or HashSet themselves are not applied here.
